concepts.title: Literary — Stories and Poems
concepts.description: Literary — Stories and Poems — part of the chapter on Reading and Comprehension.

concepts.title: Identifying Main Idea and Themes
concepts.description: Strategies to identify the primary topic or central message of a paragraph or story, distinguishing it from minor details.

concepts.title: Vocabulary in Context
concepts.description: Techniques for deducing the meaning of unfamiliar words and phrases by analyzing surrounding sentences rather than using a dictionary.
key_ideas: Using synonyms and antonyms as clues

concepts.title: Sequencing and Cause-Effect
concepts.description: Understanding the chronological order of events in a narrative and analyzing the relationship between actions and their consequences.

concepts.title: Reading Posters and Visual Texts
concepts.description: Interpreting information presented in non-linear formats common in daily life, such as posters, notices, advertisements, and timetables.
key_ideas: Scanning for specific details (dates, times, venues)
Understanding the purpose of a notice or poster

concepts.title: Making Inferences
concepts.description: The ability to 'read between the lines' to understand character feelings, motives, or events that are not explicitly stated by the author.
key_ideas: Combining text evidence with background knowledge
Predicting future outcomes based on current events

concepts.title: Tenses — Simple, Continuous, Perfect
concepts.description: Tenses — Simple, Continuous, Perfect — part of the chapter on Grammar.

concepts.title: Modals — can, could, may, should
concepts.description: Modals — can, could, may, should — part of the chapter on Grammar.

concepts.title: Punctuation — Full Stop, Comma, Question Mark, Apostrophe
concepts.description: Punctuation — Full Stop, Comma, Question Mark, Apostrophe — part of the chapter on Grammar.

concepts.title: Articles — A, An, The
concepts.description: Understanding the difference between definite and indefinite articles and how to use them correctly before nouns based on vowel and consonant sounds.
key_ideas: Use of 'The' for specific or unique nouns

concepts.title: Adjectives and Degrees of Comparison
concepts.description: Learning how to use adjectives to describe nouns and using positive, comparative, and superlative forms to compare objects or people.

concepts.title: Prepositions of Place and Time
concepts.description: Using words that indicate the relationship between a noun and other parts of the sentence, specifically focusing on location, direction, and time.

concepts.title: Conjunctions — Joining Sentences
concepts.description: Using connecting words to join words, phrases, or short sentences together to form compound sentences.

concepts.title: Subject-Verb Agreement
concepts.description: Ensuring that the verb in a sentence matches the subject in number (singular or plural).
key_ideas: Rules for pronouns (I, You, He, She, It, They)
Identifying the subject in a sentence

concepts.title: Essay Writing — Descriptive
concepts.description: Essay Writing — Descriptive — part of the chapter on Writing Skills.
key_ideas: Step-by-step problem solving for essay writing

key_ideas: Core principles of formal and informal letters

concepts.title: Notice Writing
concepts.description: Notice Writing — part of the chapter on Writing Skills.
key_ideas: Step-by-step problem solving for notice writing

concepts.title: Paragraph Writing
concepts.description: Learn to structure a single, cohesive paragraph focusing on one central idea, using a topic sentence, supporting details, and a concluding sentence.

concepts.title: Picture Composition
concepts.description: Develop skills to observe a visual image and translate those observations into a descriptive text, focusing on details, actions, and setting.
key_ideas: Observation and interpretation of visual cues
Using present continuous tense for ongoing actions
Connecting visual elements to create a narrative

concepts.title: Message Writing
concepts.description: Learn the format and technique for writing short, informal messages to convey information to someone who is not present (e.g., taking a phone message).
key_ideas: Converting direct speech to reported summary
Using an informal but polite tone

concepts.title: Diary Entry
concepts.description: Practice writing personal reflections on daily events, feelings, and experiences in a specific diary format.
key_ideas: Format: Date, Day, Time, and Salutation
Maintaining an informal and reflective tone

concepts.title: Story Writing from Outlines
concepts.description: Construct a complete story based on provided hints or outlines, focusing on plot development, character, and moral.
key_ideas: Developing a plot with a beginning, middle, and end

concepts.title: Contextual Word Meanings
concepts.description: Contextual Word Meanings — part of the chapter on Vocabulary and Word Power.
key_ideas: Core principles of contextual word meanings
Step-by-step problem solving for contextual word meanings
Real-world applications of contextual word meanings

concepts.title: One Word Substitution
concepts.description: One Word Substitution — part of the chapter on Vocabulary and Word Power.
key_ideas: Core principles of one word substitution
Step-by-step problem solving for one word substitution
Real-world applications of one word substitution

concepts.title: Synonyms and Antonyms
concepts.description: Identifying words with similar meanings (synonyms) and opposite meanings (antonyms) to enhance descriptive writing.
key_ideas: Synonyms are words that mean the same thing (e.g., happy/joyful).
Antonyms are words that mean the opposite (e.g., hot/cold).
Using varied vocabulary to avoid repetition.

concepts.title: Compound Words
concepts.description: Learning how to combine two distinct words to create a new word with a specific meaning.
key_ideas: Combining nouns to form new objects (e.g., Sun + Flower = Sunflower).
Understanding that the meaning of the compound word relates to its parts.
Identifying closed, open, and hyphenated compound words.

concepts.title: Homophones and Homonyms
concepts.description: Distinguishing between words that sound the same but have different spellings and meanings.
key_ideas: Using context clues to select the correct spelling.
Understanding homonyms (same spelling, different meaning like 'bark').

concepts.title: Prefixes and Suffixes
concepts.description: Modifying root words by adding affixes to change their meaning or grammatical function.
key_ideas: Using prefixes like un-, dis-, re- to negate or change action.
Using suffixes like -ly, -ness, -ful to change word class (e.g., noun to adjective).
Identifying root words within complex terms.

concepts.title: Introduction to Idioms
concepts.description: Understanding figurative language where the phrase means something different from the literal definition of its words.
key_ideas: Distinguishing between literal and figurative meaning.
Using idioms to add color and expression to speech and writing.
